---
title: "Intracranial MTG recordings"
output: html_document
---

Patients 2 and 4 contribute the specified bipolar channels. The MTG window is read from the outcome functional regression. ITPC is calculated across trials within each patient and condition. Participant-level plots summarize ITPC and behavioural measures.

## Read and match data

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
root <- Sys.getenv("DUAL_AGENCY_ROOT", unset=getwd())
while(!file.exists(file.path(root,"dual-agency-pathways.Rproj"))) {
  parent <- dirname(root)
  if(identical(parent,root)) stop("Open the project or set DUAL_AGENCY_ROOT.")
  root <- parent
}
source(file.path(root,"analysis/common.R"),encoding="UTF-8",local=TRUE)
source(file.path(project_root,"analysis/06_ieeg/lib/pearson_utils.R"), encoding="UTF-8", local=TRUE)
out <- out_dir("06_ieeg"); inputs <- cache_dir("06_ieeg"); fig <- out_dir("06_ieeg", TRUE)
```

```{r}
w <- read_functional_windows() %>%
  filter(binding=="outcome", region=="MTG-R")
used <- read_csv(file.path(inputs,"windows_used.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE)
key <- c("binding","region","primary_lower_ms","primary_upper_ms")
stopifnot(nrow(w)==1, isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(w[key]), as.data.frame(used[key]), check.attributes=FALSE)))
feature_df <- read_csv(file.path(inputs,"feature/ieeg_MTGR.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE)
behavior_df <- read_csv(file.path(data_root,"06_ieeg/behavior_ieeg.csv"), show_col_types=FALSE)
map_df <- tibble(subject=c("2","4"), label=c("chan83-chan84","chan10-chan11"))
conds <- c("Voluntary_OutcomeOnsetReportSound","Involuntary_OutcomeOnsetReportSound")
trial_keys <- c("subject","condition","trial")
feature_df <- feature_df %>% mutate(subject=as.character(subject), trial=as.character(trial))
behavior_df <- behavior_df %>% mutate(subject=as.character(subject), trial=as.character(trial))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(feature_df[trial_keys]), !anyDuplicated(behavior_df[trial_keys]))
expected <- tidyr::expand_grid(subject=map_df$subject, condition=conds) %>% left_join(map_df, by="subject")
actual <- distinct(feature_df, subject, label, condition)
stopifnot(nrow(anti_join(expected,actual,by=c("subject","label","condition")))==0,
          nrow(anti_join(actual,expected,by=c("subject","label","condition")))==0)
matched <- inner_join(feature_df, behavior_df, by=trial_keys, relationship="one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(matched)==nrow(feature_df), all(is.finite(matched$behavior_value)))
```

## Summarize patient data

```{r patient-summary}
patient_summary <- matched %>% group_by(subject,label,condition) %>%
  summarise(n_trials=n(), behavior_mean=mean(behavior_value), behavior_sd=sd(behavior_value),
            across(ends_with("_bandITPC"), first), .groups="drop")
write_csv(patient_summary,file.path(out,"patient_summary.csv"))
knitr::kable(patient_summary, digits=4)
```

## Plot and save

```{r plot-parameters}
condition_pick <- "Voluntary_OutcomeOnsetReportSound"
subjects_order <- c("4","2")
fill_vals <- c("10-11"="#0BDA51", "83-84"="#0BDA51")
shape_vals <- c("10-11"=21, "83-84"=24)
itpc_cols <- c(Delta="Delta_bandITPC", Theta="Theta_bandITPC")
y_limits <- c(-200,600)
y_breaks <- c(-200,0,200,400,600)
point_size <- 1.2
point_alpha <- .50
point_nudge <- -.12
jitter_width <- .15
summary_nudge <- .13
range_cap_width <- .18
plot_width <- 7.0/2.54
plot_height <- 6.6/2.54
```

```{r behavior-itpc-plot, fig.width=plot_width, fig.height=plot_height}
stopifnot(condition_pick %in% conds)
set.seed(20261028)
p_MTGR <- plot_half_violin_subjects(
  behavior_df=behavior_df, feature_df=feature_df, condition_pick=condition_pick,
  map_df=map_df, subjects_order=subjects_order, fill_vals=fill_vals,
  point_shapes=shape_vals, itpc_cols=itpc_cols,
  y_limits=y_limits, y_breaks=y_breaks, point_size=point_size,
  point_alpha=point_alpha, point_nudge=point_nudge, jitter_width=jitter_width,
  summary_nudge=summary_nudge, range_cap_width=range_cap_width,
  base_size=6,x_text_size=6,y_text_size=6,y_title_size=7,
  summary_linewidth=.4,median_linewidth=.6,summary_color="grey45")
tag <- if(condition_pick==conds[1]) "Voluntary" else "Involuntary"
for(ext in "pdf") ggsave(file.path(fig,paste0("ieeg_behaviour.",ext)),p_MTGR,
  width=plot_width,height=plot_height,units="in",device=if(ext=="pdf")cairo_pdf else"png",dpi=300,bg="white")
p_MTGR
```
